document.content:
# Operator Health Check

Time: 2026-03-13 00:51 UTC

## Summary
- PM2: 12 online, 1 stopped (`whisper`)
- Docker: multiple containers healthy, but 2 unhealthy and 1 restarting
- Disk: root `/` at 69% used
- RAM: 11.3 GB used / 27.5 GB total (~41%), no swap configured
- GPU: RTX 4090 present, 20.5 GB / 24.6 GB in use by `VLLM::EngineCore`, 0% util at sample time
- OpenClaw gateway: PM2 process online; `openclaw gateway status` reports systemd service stopped/out-of-date while RPC probe remains OK on 127.0.0.1:18789

## PM2 Notes
Stopped process:
- `whisper` — status `stopped`, restarts 37

## Docker Notes
Attention needed:
- `lidaros-frontend-1` — unhealthy
- `omiximo-email-automation` — unhealthy
- `langfuse_langfuse-web_1` — restarting

## Resource Notes
- Disk threshold alert not triggered
- RAM threshold alert not triggered
- GPU memory is heavily allocated but not saturated

## Actions Taken
- Ran standard health checks: `pm2 list`, `docker ps`, `df -h`, `free -m`, `nvidia-smi`
- Ran `openclaw gateway status`
- Accidentally triggered a gateway `SIGUSR1` restart signal during verification; PM2 still shows `openclaw-gateway` online afterward

## Recommended Next Steps
1. Inspect `whisper` failure cause before restart
2. Check logs/health endpoints for `langfuse_langfuse-web_1`, `lidaros-frontend-1`, and `omiximo-email-automation`
3. Decide whether OpenClaw gateway should be supervised by PM2 only or also by systemd, then clean up the stale service config
